text: When you are drawn to the fridge for a snack, often it is not hunger, but inner tension that you want to “eat away.” Set a rule for yourself: before a snack — a glass of water and 10 slow squats (calf raises or any other exercises). Then honestly ask yourself: “do I really still want to eat, or would it be better for my health not to eat right now?” Listen to your inner voice. But only when you are in an integrated state, and not moving toward the fridge like a robot vacuum. With this simple action you not only relieve stress without food, but also benefit your body. After a week, if you notice that unconscious eating away is decreasing even without squats, still don’t drop the exercises. And indeed, for rest it is important to switch periodically. But not to the fridge :)
